message.content:
`docker start` is used to start **containers**, not the Docker daemon itself.  
If you want to bring up the Docker service (the Docker Desktop/Engine) on Windows, you can do it from PowerShell or CMD:

```powershell
# PowerShell – start the Docker service
Start-Service -Name com.docker.service
```

or

```cmd
:: CMD – start the Docker service
net start com.docker.service
```

Once the service is running, you can then start individual containers with `docker start <container-id-or-name>`.

---

### Quick recap

| Task | Command |
|------|---------|
| Start Docker service (daemon) | `Start-Service com.docker.service` (PowerShell) or `net start com.docker.service` (CMD) |
| Start a specific container | `docker start <container-id-or-name>` |

Let me know if you need help starting a particular container or troubleshooting any errors!
